name: notch-launch-film
description: Deterministic HTML/Canvas source for the Notch launch film (https://youtu.be/evf-Ct_pw5A)

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -y -i notch-video.mp4 -i score.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11,aresample=48000 -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest notch-launch.mp4
scripts.build: npm run video && npm run audio && npm run mux
